You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: What must accompany machinery when it is placed on the market?

[1] manufacturer or authorised representative — ensureDeclarationAccompanies — EC declaration of conformity accompanies the machinery (EC declaration of conformity accompanies the machinery) [condition: before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]

[3] manufacturer or authorised representative — ensureSatisfiesEssentialRequirements — machinery satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements in Annex I (machinery satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements in Annex I) [condition: before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[4] CE marking — mustBeAffixedBefore — machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service (machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service) [REG, Art. 24(2)]

[9] manufacturer or authorised representative — provideInformation — necessary information, such as instructions (necessary information, such as instructions) [condition: before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[10] Machinery — mustBeAccompaniedBy — EC declaration of conformity (EC declaration of conformity) [condition: safeguard clause applies to machinery covered by this Directive] [DIR, Art. 11(1)]
[11] importers — mustEnsureManufacturerComplies — requirements set out in Article 11(5), (6) and (8) (requirements set out in Article 11(5), (6) and (8)) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[12] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that technical documentation is prepared — relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B (relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[13] distributors — verifyBeforeMarketing — machinery or related product bears the CE marking (machinery or related product bears the CE marking) [condition: before making the machinery or related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[14] manufacturer or authorised representative — shallEnsure — Article 13 procedure has been completed (Article 13 procedure has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[15] importers — mustPlaceOnMarket — only compliant machinery or related products (only compliant machinery or related products) [REG, Art. 13(1)]
[16] CE marking — shallBeAffixedTo — machinery (machinery) [DIR, Art. 16(2)]
[17] Importers — ensure — machinery or related product is accompanied by the required documents (machinery or related product is accompanied by the required documents) [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[18] Manufacturers — shall ensure machinery bears — a designation of model, series or type (a designation of model, series or type) [REG, Art. 10(5)]
[19] manufacturer or authorised representative — ensureAvailable — technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A (technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A) [condition: before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[20] Importers — mustEnsureAccompaniment — machinery or related product is accompanied by the information referred to in Article 10(7) (machinery or related product is accompanied by the information referred to in Article 10(7)) [REG, Art. 13(4)]
[21] Manufacturers — shall ensure partly completed machinery bears — its designation as partly completed machinery (its designation as partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[22] manufacturer — ceasePlacingOnMarket — machinery concerned (machinery concerned) [condition: validity of the EC-type examination certificate is not renewed] [DIR, Annex IX]
[23] CE marking — shallBeAffixedVisiblyLegiblyIndelibly — machinery or related product (machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 24(1)]
[24] Importers — mustEnsureAccompaniment — machinery or related product is accompanied by the instructions for use (machinery or related product is accompanied by the instructions for use) [REG, Art. 13(4)]
[25] partly completed machinery — canBePlacedOnMarket — only if it satisfies the relevant provisions of this Directive (only if it satisfies the relevant provisions of this Directive) [DIR, Art. 4(2)]
[26] Machinery or related products — shall only be made available on the market or put into service — they meet the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III (they meet the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III) [condition: where properly installed and maintained and used for their intended use or under conditions which can reasonably be foreseen] [REG, Art. 8]
[27] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — shall draw up — technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B (technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[28] Machinery — mustBearCEMarking — the CE Marking (see Annex III) (the CE Marking (see Annex III)) [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]

[31] distributors — verifyBeforeMarketing — manufacturer has complied with Article 10(5) and (6) and importer has complied with Article 13(3) (manufacturer has complied with Article 10(5) and (6) and importer has complied with Article 13(3)) [condition: before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[32] Manufacturers — shall ensure — machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: alternatively, see the internet-address option] [REG, Art. 10(8)]

[36] Machinery — mustBear — CE marking (CE marking) [condition: safeguard clause applies to machinery covered by this Directive] [DIR, Art. 11(1)]
[37] Machinery or related products — shallBeMarked — visibly, legibly and indelibly (visibly, legibly and indelibly) [condition: in addition to the marking requirements in Articles 10 and 24] [REG, Annex III, 1.7.3]
[38] Manufacturers — shallEnsure — partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B (partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B) [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[39] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that assembly instructions are prepared — assembly instructions described in Annex VI (assembly instructions described in Annex VI) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[40] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that a declaration is drawn up — declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B (declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[41] Required identification information — is provided on — the packaging or in a document accompanying the machinery (the packaging or in a document accompanying the machinery) [condition: where the size or nature of the machinery does not allow it to bear the information] [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[42] manufacturer or authorised representative — carryOutConformityAssessment — appropriate conformity assessment procedures under Article 12 (appropriate conformity assessment procedures under Article 12) [condition: before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[43] distributors — shallVerifyBefore — partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation referred to in Article 11(8) (partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation referred to in Article 11(8)) [condition: Before making partly completed machinery available on the market] [REG, Art. 16(2)]
[44] CE marking — shallBeAffixedTo — packaging and accompanying documents (packaging and accompanying documents) [condition: where affixing to the machinery or related product is not possible or not warranted on account of its nature] [REG, Art. 24(1)]
[45] machinery, related products and partly completed machinery — mayBeMadeAvailable — on the market or put into service (on the market or put into service) [condition: while ensuring a high level of protection of health and safety under this Regulation] [REG, Art. 1]
[46] All machinery — mustBeMarked — visibly, legibly and indelibly with the following minimum particulars (visibly, legibly and indelibly with the following minimum particulars) [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]

[98] instructions for use — isProvidedBy — the manufacturer (the manufacturer) [condition: when the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 3(17)]
[99] Manufacturer or authorised representative — mustTransmitInformation — relevant information about the partly completed machinery (relevant information about the partly completed machinery) [condition: in response to a reasoned request by national authorities] [ur10e-manual, p. 227]
[100] Manufacturer or authorised representative — shall transmit — relevant information about the partly completed machinery (relevant information about the partly completed machinery) [condition: in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities] [ur5e-manual, p. 220]

[102] Manufacturer of the machinery — must carry out — risk assessment and apply appropriate protective measures (risk assessment and apply appropriate protective measures) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 21]

[104] apparecchi — must have — installation, use and maintenance manual (installation, use and maintenance manual) [condition: only for CE-marked appliances] [igea-equipment, p. 5]
[105] aggiudicatario — must issue — verification report (verification report) [igea-equipment, p. 5]

response.text: {"reasoning": "Facts that say what must accompany machinery when it is placed on the market are [1] and [2]. Fact [1] requires the EC declaration of conformity to accompany the machinery before it is placed on the market or put into service (DIR, Art. 5(1)). Fact [2] requires all machinery to be accompanied by instructions in the official Community language(s) of the Member State where it is placed on the market and/or put into service (DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4). Facts [0] and [43]-[49] concern partly completed machinery or other subjects, and [10] is conditional on a safeguard clause, so they are excluded. Today's date does not change these conditions.","kind":"set","value":["EC declaration of conformity (accompanies the machinery, before placing it on the market and/or putting it into service)","instructions in the official Community language or languages of the Member State where it is placed on the market and/or put into service"],"text":"Machinery placed on the market must be accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity (DIR, Art. 5(1)) and by instructions in the official Community language(s) of the Member State where it is placed on the market and/or put into service (DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4).","used":[1,2]}
